title: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2004, Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2004, Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the flight combat category, Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
